##### Project general facts

Nasaq District in Aljada offers a dynamic residential experience, perfectly positioned between a vibrant boulevard filled with shops and restaurants and a serene green park. This unique setting allows residents to enjoy a balanced lifestyle, combining urban convenience with natural tranquility in one of Sharjah’s most progressive and fast-growing communities.

The development features stylish apartment buildings designed with a modern and contemporary aesthetic, complemented by a wide range of amenities. Residents benefit from exclusive access to facilities such as a private gym and swimming pool, while also being surrounded by an array of retail, dining, and entertainment options just steps from their homes. The location within Aljada ensures seamless connectivity to key attractions, including Madar and the culturally rich Naseej district, all within walking distance.

The residences are finished with modern materials and elegant interiors, featuring sleek décor and smart home technology for enhanced comfort and convenience. Each apartment comes equipped with essential kitchen appliances, including a cooking range, hood, and washer-dryer, while units are partially furnished with kitchen fittings, allowing residents to personalize their living spaces.

##### Location description and benefits

A destination where everything is at your fingertips, and where living, working, entertainment, relaxing, shopping and culture all come together. Ideally located in the heart of one of the Middle East’s most welcoming cities, Aljada is a truly all-encompassing development and the perfect place to bring up your family. With a masterplan that draws inspiration from some of Sharjah’s oldest heritage districts, Aljada is designed to provide you and your children with a stress-free yet active lifestyle. A destination where engaging design meets contemporary elegance, Aljada allows you to be all that you can be.


Aljada is Sharjah’s largest ever mixed-use destination and a transformational project for the Emirate. Alongside extensive residential districts, Aljada also hosts beautifully landscaped parks, four hotels, three schools, and a premium business district, as well as considerable shopping and dining options on its two tree-lined boulevards.


In a rapidly changing world, it’s vital to have a range of different working options close to hand. Aljada will contain an ecosystem that will not only support the growth of the UAE’s economy, but also provide jobs for thousands of young people from the Gulf and beyond. Aljada’s business park is set to be the heart of commercial activity in one of the region’s most diverse economies, and elsewhere within the city there are a wide-range of co-working and creative spaces, allowing residents and workers to collaborate. So whether you want to be an architect or an engineer, Aljada is the perfect place to set the foundations for a promising career.
